Updated 5 September 2026

Common fixes

SymptomWhat to check
Cannot reach a modelConfirm --base-url, model ID, and provider credential. Without a configured provider Orcacode can use a local model endpoint.
Write is refusedRead the current file first, use edit_file for an exact replacement, and confirm the path is inside the workspace.
Tool denied in plan modeThis is expected for shell, writes outside docs/plan/, subagents, persistent compute, processes, and MCP. Switch to normal mode after reviewing the plan.
MCP server will not connectCheck its executable is on PATH, the whitespace-split command is valid, and its credentials are in the parent environment.
Changed AGENTS.md is ignoredStart a new session or use /clear; instructions are read at session start.
Need prior long tool outputUse read_tool_result with the supplied call ID and page offset.

Useful diagnostics

$ orcacode --help
$ orcacode --list-models --openrouter
› /settings
› /extensions
› /usage

Use /usage for token totals, cache traffic, and context occupancy. Use /extensions to inspect output truncation and tool retry settings.
